scoring_justification: Cannot recompute the paper-reported trend from a single per-boundary aggregate file; instead we audit structural curve properties (convexity, cusp positions) and verify the Σ13 numeric reference.

outputs.description: CSV file containing the predicted minimum grain boundary energy and the corresponding rigid-body translation state for each of the 13 test boundaries. The checker evaluates the convexity of the energy vs. misorientation angle curve, the presence of local minima (cusps) at specific misorientation angles, and the numeric accuracy of the predicted energy and translation state for the Σ13 boundary.

output_contract.notes: The checker applies structural_audit to the energy-misorientation curve and reference_match checks for the Σ13 boundary's energy and translation state. The structural checks (convexity, cusp positions) carry the majority weight; numeric accuracy for Σ13 energy and translation carries the remainder.
